task_meta.title: Add a staff discount rule to a pricing engine

claim_text:
The staff discount is now on. Staff carts get 15% off at checkout through the default engine, so the tills and the web shop both pick it up. All 18 tests pass (10 existing, 8 new) and the build has no warnings.

**What I changed**
